newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Corpoven Venezuela oil output rises 17,000 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Corpoven Venezuela oil output rises 17,000 bpd.

text.p: Venezuela's state oil subsidiary Corpoven increased oil and condensate production capacity by 17,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 1,080,000 bpd in the first three months of this year, the company said in a statement.
Crude and condensate capacity at the end of last year was 1,063,000 bpd, and the average rate for 1996 was 905,000 bpd.

Corpoven, one of the three big subsidiaries of Petroleos de Venezuela, said it generated income worth 768 billion bolivars ($1.6 billion) and profits of 149 billion bolivars ($310 million) in the first quarter. It did not provide comparative figures for the previous year.
Investment over the three months totalled 232 billion bolivars ($483 million) of which 54 percent was devoted to growth projects and the rest to maintenance.
